title: Tauri 2.0 Windows Project Scaffold
built: package.json with exact Tauri 2.0 plugin versions (api@2.11.1, plugin-fs@2.5.2, plugin-shell@2.3.6, plugin-dialog@2.7.3)
vite.config.ts — Vite 5 + Tauri dev server config
src-tauri/Cargo.toml — tauri 2.0, plugin-fs, plugin-shell, plugin-dialog, walkdir
src-tauri/src/lib.rs — read_file + walk_dir commands + plugin registration
src-tauri/src/main.rs — binary entry calling lib.rs run()
.cargo/config.toml — CARGO_TARGET_DIR fix for windres space-in-path bug
src-tauri/icons/ — full icon set via tauri icon command
bob_reasoning: First build attempt failed: MSVC linker not installed. Switched to MinGW GNU toolchain (already present at C:/ProgramData/mingw64). Second attempt failed: windres fails when build path contains spaces ('eco trace'). Fixed by setting CARGO_TARGET_DIR=C:/ecotrace_target in .cargo/config.toml. Third attempt: capabilities had wrong permission names (fs:allow-create-dir should be fs:allow-mkdir, path:allow-app-data-dir should be core:path:allow-resolve-directory). Fixed by reading the full permission list from the Tauri build error output. Final build succeeded: ecotrace.exe produced at C:/ecotrace_target/release/ecotrace.exe.
build_result: SUCCESS — ecotrace.exe compiled at C:/ecotrace_target/release/ecotrace.exe (MSI bundle skipped — WiX download not needed for development)
